content.comment_body: Hello, I have four amplified analog signals that I want to read using [product_name]. However, when connecting, I'm unable to select [article_no] and can only pick 2x [article_no]. Did I make a mistake, and is this fixable? I tried replacing it, but the problem remains.
Could you please upload your configuration file, preferably as a ZIP file?

Please see the attached file. You should check your settings in the Parameter-VM-Mapping section, found at: Tools > Parameter-VM-Mapping. It seems you have [article_no] selected twice in the Variable Memory Configuration table. As shown in my attachment, I made a similar mistake with [article_no].
Thank you, it's working perfectly now!

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced a configuration issue when mapping analog signals and could not assign the intended VM address, leading to duplicate entries. Another user quickly identified the duplication in the Variable Memory Configuration within the Parameter-VM-Mapping section. Once the user corrected this, the issue was resolved smoothly.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to assign each analog input a distinct VM address without encountering duplication or setup errors.
